bottom_line: In patients with severe heart failure and left ventricular systolic dysfunction, dronedarone vs placebo increased all-cause mortality (hazard ratio in the dronedarone group, 2.13; 95% CI, 1.07 to 4.25).
implications: In this trial of severe heart failure with reduced left ventricular systolic function, the reported data support an early increase in all-cause mortality with dronedarone vs placebo (25/310 vs 12/317; HR 2.13, 95% CI 1.07 to 4.25), while the primary composite of death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure was not statistically different (HR 1.38, 95% CI 0.92 to 2.09). The confidence intervals do not exclude smaller or no differences for the composite endpoint, and the study was stopped early after 627 patients with a median follow-up of about 2 months.

major_points.text: Multicenter, double-blind randomized trial comparing dronedarone 400 mg twice daily vs placebo in hospitalized symptomatic heart failure with severe LV systolic dysfunction.
major_points.quote: In a multicenter study with a double-blind design, we planned to randomly assign 1000 patients who were hospitalized with symptomatic heart failure and severe left ventricular systolic dysfunction to receive 400 mg of dronedarone twice a day or placebo.

major_points.text: Primary endpoint was the composite of death from any cause or hospitalization for heart failure.
major_points.quote: The primary end point was the composite of death from any cause or hospi- talization for heart failure.

major_points.text: Trial was terminated early for safety after 627 patients were included.
major_points.quote: After inclusion of 627 patients (310 in the dronedarone group and 317 in the placebo group), the trial was prematurely terminated for safety reasons

major_points.text: During median follow-up of 2 months, deaths were higher with dronedarone than placebo (HR 2.13).
major_points.quote: During a median follow-up of 2 months, 25 patients in the dronedarone group (8.1%) and 12 patients in the placebo group (3.8%) died (hazard ratio in the dronedarone group, 2.13; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.07 to 4.25; P = 0.03).

major_points.text: Excess mortality was predominantly related to worsening heart failure (10 vs 2 deaths).
major_points.quote: The excess mortality was predominantly related to wors- ening of heart failure — 10 deaths in the dronedarone group and 2 in the placebo group.

major_points.text: Primary composite endpoint did not differ significantly between groups (HR 1.38; 95% CI, 0.92 to 2.09).
major_points.quote: The primary end point did not differ significantly between the two groups; there were 53 events in the dronedarone group (17.1%) and 40 events in the placebo group (12.6%) (hazard ratio, 1.38; 95% CI, 0.92 to 2.09; P = 0.12).

major_points.text: Serious adverse events included more reported increases in serum creatinine with dronedarone (8 vs 0).
